segments.sensitive: Many reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with acne-prone or hormonal skin, report no breakouts and a soft, hydrated feel, though one reviewer's eyelids swelled and turned red and itchy within days.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report it cleans without stripping or over-drying, though one reviewer whose skin leans dry says it made her skin much worse in winter, and another with dry skin reports burning and lingering redness.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report it controls oil throughout the day without over-drying.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or mature-combination skin report it leaves skin clean and hydrated without dryness or redness.

concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers describe it as compatible with acne-prone skin and report fewer breakouts with continued use, but one reviewer with previously controlled acne reports increased oil and breakouts after over a month of use.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report the cleanser soothes redness, but two reviewers describe new redness and bumps or swollen, itchy eyelids after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the cleanser stripped her skin after a single use, causing a gritty, pilling texture and what she describes as a barrier issue with lasting redness and itchiness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the cleanser does not dry out skin and can even feel moisturizing, though it can be drying if used regularly on already-dry skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it controls oil throughout the day without leaving skin dry or tight.

extraits.texte: I was using LRP purifying cleanser but switched to this because i read its deep cleansing without stripping your skin. I want to start off by saying i love byoma products. So i was very excited. I can be acne prone but ive had it under control. After over a month of using this, ive noticed an increased oil amount on my face and ive been breaking out. I assumed it was stress or other products, so i ignored it. But finally i got annoyed and switched back to LRP. Immediately changed my skin. Im confident that this cleanser was the issue, which is upsetting

I really loved this product for the first few days, it foams up so nicely and my face felt really soft after using it. However it quickly started to make my eyelids swell and get all red and itchy. Looked it up on Reddit and quickly learned I'm not alone :( I've never thrown a product into the trash so quickly.

extraits.titre: Stripped my skin after one use!
extraits.texte: After seeing so many positive reviews on this cleanser, I decided I would give this one a try. I usually use the prequel oil cleanser and gleanser. I wanted to see if a foaming cleanser would do a better job cleaning out some of my clogged pores. The first time I tried this cleanser, my hands and face were damp but the cleanser still separated on my face while I was lathering it. When I went to rinse, it felt like a weird gritty texture and my skin felt like it was pilling. I've never had a cleanser pill before so I thought maybe I didnt have my face wet enough even though i was in the shower. I tried it again the next day and it lathered better but still left my face with weird pilling and my skin felt stripped immediately. Its the following day and my skin is red and itchy. This cleanser did not work for me and seemed to have caused a barrier issue from two uses. Very disappointed and will be returning!

Burning sensation while it was on my face ): Face felt dry and had some redness that lasted a while after washing it off. My skin has not reacted this way to a product in recent years. I am a dry skin girly, so probably wouldnt recommend for anyone else w/ dry skin.

extraits.titre: My short review for Byoma Rice Cleanser
extraits.texte: I received this product for free for review: My skin is on the dry side and gets even more reactive during the winter, but this cleanser still feels light and gentle. It leaves my skin clean without drying it out. The foam is soft, removes sunscreen well, and keeps my skin smooth and balanced. Great for daily use!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really love the design of the packaging and size! It's pretty on my skincare vanity! This cleanser is a gel texture and it kind of smells like sweet tarts! I have really oily skin with large pores so I like a deep clean cleansing. I love that this can do that without making my skin feel tight and dry.
